text:
maria: Quick share — created an 'Aspirations → Results' one-pager to streamline self-reviews + manager prep. Meant for ICs to fill in ~10 mins and for managers to review in ~5.

maria: Core sections: 1) 3-line impact summary, 2) Evidence bullets (metrics/artifacts), 3) What I learned, 4) Blockers/needs, 5) 1-2 stretch goals for next cycle.

tom: Love that. Can we add a single-line 'Customer value' field? helps alignment.

maria: Yes — added. Also added a tiny rubric for magnitude: `0-3` scale with 0=no impact, 3=company-level.

anu: Quick nit — for Evidence bullets can we suggest tags like `metrics:`, `link:` so managers can scan.

leo: Also include a one-sentence manager prompt: "Suggested feedback focus: impact, clarity, growth areas". Keeps 1:1s focused.

maria: Good call. Draft snippet I'm proposing:

maria: ```
3-line impact: ...
Evidence (2-4 bullets): metrics: ..., link: ...
What I learned: ...
Blockers/needs: ...
Stretch goals (1-2): ...
Customer value (1 line): ...
Magnitude (0-3): ...
``` 

tom: Perfect. Can we also add a checkbox for "Calibration note" for managers to flag if they want to escalate to calibration sync?

leo: yes — add `calibration: yes/no (reason)` field.

anu: Will test this with my org next week, will send a filled example.

jess-bot: Reminder set — self-review template will be posted to handbook + optional filler session (30m) next Wed.

maria: Thanks all — will iterate based on pilot. If anyone wants a Google short-form to copy, DM me.
